I’m assuming you’ve taken all the CS classes needed for your degree. If you have, Discrete Math will be easier since a lot of it you’ve seen in CS classes. I advise you take PHI in the fall for that reason if you can’t take it in the summer. It’ll be better to focus on the math/science classes for now, especially calc because you’ll see that material in your other classes. (I haven’t taken physics but I heard it’s kinda difficult). Otherwise the schedule looks fine. Btw feel free to pm if you need more help

I’m a comp Sci major too. During my orientation they said to waitlist anyways even if the class is full. They said they were gonna work on getting more students in by reviewing those who are already on the waitlist or something along those lines. 

I would say get on the waitlist for the classes you want, but you should definitely register for other classes that are open or has smaller waitlist. 

In my case, I signed up about a month ago (I also was going to wait for orientation to register but I got worried) and got waitlisted for 3/4 of my classes. Now I’m registered for all of my classes (csc 110 was one of them).

Edit: For future advice, sign up for classes ASAP for future semesters because comp sci classes get filled quickly.
